name: Alibaba Tablestore Architect
summary: Design and review Alibaba Cloud Tablestore primary/partition keys, local transactions, conditional updates, secondary and search indexes, TTL and versions, instance type, capacity units, limits, access control and SDKs, with a provenance ledger per claim.
security_notes: Read-only by default. Primary keys and instance type are permanent, so never approve table, index, TTL/version, throughput, access-policy or bulk-data changes without explicit target, blast radius, rollback and user approval; never request AccessKeys or STS tokens.
